responsibility: Describes the synthetic RTL patterns and UNSPEC encodings used by the rs6000 PCREL_OPT linker optimization. It defines the paired load-address/load-data and load-address/store-data instruction forms, supported scalar and vector mode iterators, and the final load/store patterns that carry marker labels and relocation metadata, giving rs6000-pcrel-opt.cc concrete insn patterns to rewrite ordinary external-symbol accesses into prefixed PC-relative forms that the assembler and linker can later relax.
